summary: News Corporation filed an 8-K on August 20, 2026, disclosing daily ASX buyback transaction reports under its existing stock repurchase program authorizing up to $1 billion of Class A (NWSA) and Class B (NWS) common stock. No new price, premium, stake, or closing terms were set; exhibits 99.1 and 99.2 merely reproduce the ASX-provided disclosures. No advisor or board recommendation is named, and the program has no fixed expiration or regulatory clock. Watch cadence of repurchases, ASX disclosure mechanics, and any acceleration or program expansion as a signal of management's capital-return stance.
